blocking_corrections: MENGER BUG (spine, inherited by all): algo.maxFlow over unit-capacity EDGES counts edge-disjoint paths, not vertex-disjoint. Seven claims laundered through one shared intermediate score 7, not 1 - the exact echo-chamber case the spine exists to defeat. Requires node-splitting (:Source -> v_in -[cap 1]-> v_out). ~30m. NON-NEGOTIABLE before build.

NO STORED PROCEDURES in FalkorDB: 'a single Cypher procedure names a winner' is unbuildable; algo.* are built-ins, there is no CREATE PROCEDURE. What ships is a parameterised query the client sends. README wording must change or the panel that wrote the engine falsifies our one differentiating claim on first read.

WRONG SELECTOR: algo.betweenness ranks high-throughput intermediaries, not high-impact sources - a leaf source cited by 94 claims has betweenness ~0. Use out-degree/reachability if the counterfactual layer ships.

SPINE IS 3h+, NOT 2h15m (Engineer repricing): max-flow is per source-claim pair, dijkstra per path, pageRank global - that is an UNWIND orchestration plus a client-side fold, not one query. Under this correction only a +35m layer fits the budget.
LATENCY PROBE must time algo.maxFlow at target graph size, not only GRAPH.COPY. max-flow is the most expensive procedure in the verified set and the corpus must be big enough to be convincing.
